title: File transfer
description: Local and SSH files. Collapsing this panel keeps transfers running.
permanentDelete: Permanently delete this remote item and its contents? This cannot be undone.
recycleDelete: Move this item to the system recycle bin?
name: Name
truncated: Only a bounded prefix is shown.
notConnected: Connect an SSH host to browse files.
invalidName: This filename cannot be represented safely on the target.
directoryLimit: Directory exceeds the safety limit (20,000 entries / 50,000 recursive items).
entryLimit: Too many retained entries. Reopen the file browser.
staleEntry: The entry changed. Refresh and try again.
pathBusy: A transfer is using this path. Stop it first.
sourceChanged: Source changed during transfer. Retry after it stops changing.
commitUnknown: Commit result is unknown. Verify target before retrying.
replaceUnsupported: This server does not support safe replacement. Keep both or skip.
previewUnsupported: Preview unavailable for this file type or encoding.
previewLimit: Image exceeds the 20 MiB / 40 megapixel preview limit.
unsupportedTransfer: Only cross-panel copies of regular files and folders are supported.
routeChanged: The SSH route changed. Submit a new transfer after reviewing the host.
cleanupFailed: Could not remove the temporary file. Its path is shown below.
journalDamaged: Task history is damaged and preserved. New history is not being saved.
hostUsedByFiles: This host is in use by file operations.
connectionFailed: Connection failed. Check network and host settings.
sftpUnavailable: SFTP subsystem unavailable. Check the server configuration.
directUnknown: Remote transfer outcome is unknown. Verify it has stopped before retrying or cleaning up.
